_doc: Farhold's spine. Eight objectives over one star system, each counted from an event the game already fires — no objective needs new bookkeeping. Finish them all and the survey is complete. Original names only.
title: The Long Survey
blurb: One system, one surveyor, and a ledger nobody else will ever read. Walk it, chart it, and come back alive.

objectives.name: Worlds walked
objectives.desc: Set foot on three different planets.

objectives.name: Kills
objectives.desc: Put down a hundred of whatever lives out there.

objectives.name: Something legendary
objectives.desc: Find a legendary, unique or set piece.

objectives.name: Settle the grudge
objectives.desc: Kill the thing that killed you.

reputation._doc: Finishing work for a settlement raises your standing there. Past discountAt they knock discount off their prices.
